ProjectDescr.Name: Transcriptomic changes in the interaction between PCL1606 and FZB42
ProjectDescr.Title: Transcriptomic changes in the interaction between PCL1606 and FZB42
ProjectDescr.Description: We report the application of a high-throughput technique, RNA-seq, to study the transcriptomic response of P. chlororaphis and Bacillus amyloliquefaciens growing in co-cultures in King B solid medium Overall design: Single colonies of PCL1606 and FZB42 WT and the GlpK mutant were grown overnight in LB medium at 30°C. Overnight cultures were diluted to a starting OD600 of 0.01 in the same medium and 2 µl were spotted on King B plates alone and in interaction between PCL1606 and the Bacillus strains.
